summary: Codex for Open Source lets eligible open-source maintainers apply for six months of ChatGPT Pro with Codex for day-to-day coding, triage, review, and maintainer workflows, plus conditional Codex Security access and API credits through the Codex Open Source Fund for eligible OSS workflows. Selection does not guarantee all three benefits: OpenAI determines which benefits are awarded, and their duration, scope and timing may vary. API credits and Codex Security are optional additional benefits that may require separate review, eligibility checks or terms. Security use requires repository ownership or authorization to review it. Follow award-specific activation or redemption deadlines. Core maintainers and widely used public projects should apply; edge cases can explain their ecosystem role.
claim_steps: Confirm you're a core maintainer or run a widely used public open-source project.
Apply via the form linked on developers.openai.com/community/codex-for-oss (rolling review; submitting agrees to the Codex for Open Source Program Terms).
If selected, check the award: OpenAI determines which benefits you receive and their duration, scope and timing; selection does not guarantee the full advertised bundle.
API credits and Codex Security are optional additional benefits and may require separate review, eligibility checks and terms.
Use Codex Security only for repositories you own or are authorized to review; OpenAI may require proof of control or authorization.
Follow the award's redemption or activation instructions and any specified deadline; unredeemed benefits may expire.
